threads.heading: Topics
threads.description: News in the topics you follow:

noOrg.subject: Create your team’s org chart
noOrg.title: Your Rolebase account is ready
noOrg.paragraph1: Hi {{name}}, all that’s left is to create your organization.
noOrg.paragraph2: Give it a name, then add your main roles and the people who hold them. You watch the org chart come together as you go.
noOrg.paragraph3: Then invite your team so everyone can see who does what.

noSetup.subject: Finish the {{org}} org chart
noSetup.title: {{org}} is almost ready
noSetup.paragraph1: Hi {{name}}, your organization {{org}} is created. All that’s left is to choose how it works and add its main roles.
noSetup.paragraph2: It takes two minutes: the org chart comes together as you go, and you can change everything afterwards.

noInvite.subject: Show your team the {{org}} org chart
noInvite.title: Bring your team into {{org}}
noInvite.paragraph1: Hi {{name}}, the {{org}} org chart is in place. Now invite the people you work with.
noInvite.paragraph2: Each colleague who joins finds their roles and knows who to turn to for each topic. You can then prepare the next meeting together.
noInvite.paragraph3: To invite someone, all you need is their email address.
